summaryZh: Aran 实验室开发连接工程与生物学的生物集成平台，聚焦诊断和治疗中的临床需求。实验室结合电、机械、化学与生物工程，开发 BioMEMS、生物传感、芯片实验室、药物递送及植入器件，以识别衰老和癌症相关标志物并改善生物制剂递送。
researchQuestions: 如何利用生物电子与微型器件改善疾病诊断和生物制剂递送？

evidence.quote: At the Aran Lab at UC San Diego

We focus on developing novel bio-microelectromechanical systems (BioMEMS) and integrating electrical, mechanical, chemical, and bioengineering approaches to address unmet clinical needs in diagnostics and therapeutics.
Our current research spans biosensing, lab-on-a-chip systems, drug delivery, and implantable devices designed to identify age- and cancer-related biomarkers and improve the delivery of biologics.
